# Sequence decode fixture

`open-gop-hevc.mp4` is generated by `python3 tests/fixtures/sequence/generate-hevc.py`
using FFmpeg with libx265. It has open GOPs, four B-frames and a one-second keyframe
interval at 24 fps. Every frame carries a ten-bit black/white frame number and a moving
bar. The browser test trims into the second GOP and checks the exported source-frame
identity, including the next GOP boundary. Native video is checked within one frame
because its seeks truncate fractional microseconds.

The fixture declares BT.709 colour metadata. Native video and WebCodecs can apply
different colour transforms to untagged HEVC, so colour fidelity is not inferred from
this decode check. The other golden tests compare pixels with strict tolerances.

This is synthetic open-GOP coverage. It does not cover every iPhone camera profile.
